descriptions.text: Just Wait Until Your Daddy Gets Home – Wheeled Bomb. Type: High Yield Thermobaric Explosive. Also imbues Fear within blast radius. Effect: I hope you're paid up on your homeowner's insurance. Status: 250. Fortified. Boom.

beats.headline: A bomb for Bomo
beats.text: The plan: send Bomo out of the personal space into the Zockau saferoom with a very large bomb, step outside, and level the town with half an hour on the timer. The bomb starts from blocks of Nitro Sludge Mordecai left on the sapper's table, a by-product of a shield potion that look like squares of uncooked ramen: inert, but each the equivalent of several hundred pounds of ammonium nitrate when vaporized hot enough. Carl finds the mix by trial and error and packs it into a broken live ammo ball, an egg-shaped clamshell, welded shut. It stands about five feet tall, so he builds a cart Bomo can pull, and adds Fear, because why not.

beats.headline: A knife in the door
beats.text: Minutes before the hunters are loosed, Carl pulls the cart from the bomber's studio to the door. Bomo will open it, Donut will cast Clockwork Triplicate so a clockwork Bomo appears in the space outside, and the clockwork one will roll the bomb out. Bomo opens the door, and a note is stuck to the outside with a knife. Vrah: every hunter is now protected from further explosions, so he would only be killing his precious NPCs, and she has ordered the town guards to worship Emberus. Sorry, Bomo, Carl says. They will save him and the bomb for another time. He writes come and get it on the note and tosses it out.

beats.headline: Out the saferoom door
beats.text: Carl rams a gonorrhea arrow into Vrah's neck just before her shield pops up, and he and Donut vault into the saferoom. The wheeled bomb is right there at the door, the one he wanted to use to level Zockau, with the Sledge peering out at two mantises rushing toward them. Cover your ears, Carl shouts, kicks it out the door and slams it. Donut has been over this: she can't cover her... Bam. The saferoom rocks and everyone rolls like billiard balls. The blast kills the three remaining mantises despite their protection against explosions, an ursine guy and a bunch of mobs in the woods. Lucia has got away, and so has Vrah, rocketing into the air.

beats.headline: Now the size of a thermos
beats.text: In a very narrow room, against three guards moving as if fast-forwarded, Carl drops his second-largest bomb. Its first version was Just Wait Until Your Daddy Gets Home, used on the sixth floor. This one packs about the same punch without the Fear, self-contained in a device the size of a thermos instead of one so big it needed wheels, a thermobaric blast that incinerates anything within a hundred meters. Louis has fifty of them on Party Planner, no more because the explosive dust is a pain to make. The AI has helpfully named it The Waffle Maker.
